description.en: A self-hosted email relay with webhooks, reusable templates, and delivery insights.
description.zh: 可自行托管的邮件中继，支持 Webhook、邮件模板与用量查看。

source.description: Self-hosted email relay with webhook triggers, templates, and usage dashboard

subject.en: Original violet and teal faceted dove with pink blossoms
subject.zh: 保留原图的紫青色碎片化鸽子与粉色花枝

description.en: The dove, shoulder curve, watchful eye, and surrounding blossom group retain their original layout. This pass does not use any superseded neck-extension study.
description.zh: 鸽子、肩部曲线、专注眼神与周围花枝均保留原来布局，不采用此前已撤回的延长颈部版本。

description.en: Violet, blue, and mint facets remain the original bird; the existing pink blossoms form the signature accent group. All foreground pixels and detached petals are preserved.
description.zh: 紫、蓝和薄荷色碎片构成原来的鸟，既有粉色花枝是标志性的点缀组。所有前景像素与飘落花瓣均保留。

title.zh: 紫色纸面上的花瓣压纹

description.en: Sparse elongated petals sit at the corners of a muted violet field. Fine grain, offset edge light, and a shallow shadow keep the real blossom group in front.
description.zh: 稀疏修长的花瓣纹位于柔和紫色底面的角落，细颗粒、偏移边光与浅阴影让真正的花枝点缀保持在视觉前方。

sizeNote.en: The violet silhouette and pink blossom arc remain distinct at 32 px. At 16 px small petals and feather facets merge; use the transparent foreground for browser and sidebar marks.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时紫色轮廓与粉色花枝弧线仍能区分；16 像素时细花瓣与羽毛碎片会合并。浏览器和侧栏标记使用透明前景。

goal.en: Manage email templates for personal projects, send notifications through webhooks, and inspect sending records.
goal.zh: 为个人项目集中管理邮件模板，通过 Webhook 发送通知并查询发送记录。

role.zh: API 运行时与静态资源托管

role.zh: 项目、模板、日志与发送状态存储
通过 API 发送邮件

role.zh: 通过 Worker 绑定发送邮件
依赖、脚本与 HTTP 测试

description.en: Sparse, elongated petal outlines lean at different angles, carrying the blossom motif into the empty space.
description.zh: 细长花瓣以不同角度疏落排列，把鸽子身旁的花枝延伸成轻盈底纹。

alt.en: Original violet and teal faceted dove with pink blossoms on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 保留原图的紫青色碎片化鸽子与粉色花枝，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Violet and teal faceted dove with pink blossoms.
description.zh: 紫青色碎片化鸽子与粉色花枝。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥62px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 62px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
